data.narrative:
Chai Discovery is a Series C biotech company founded by Joshua Meier (former Chief AI Officer at Absci and Meta researcher) and Jack Dent (ex-Stripe), currently valued at $3.8B post-money on $400M raised. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 3 public comps (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage biotech companies in similar phases, including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), New Limit ($3.1B Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring on the current $3.8B post-money and applying a typical 1.7x Series C-to-next-stage step-up multiplier, implies $6.5B. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $3.1B, though the range among peers spans $539M to $10.3B, reflecting material dispersion. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures, standard for private companies.

The triangulated range is $2.6B to $7.4B, with a median of $4.8B. This encompasses the current $3.8B valuation within the lower-middle of the implied band. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and trajectory (not on file), the appropriate step-up multiplier given the company's AI/protein-modeling positioning relative to broader biotech cohorts, and peer selection stability as the frontier-biotech landscape rapidly revalues.
